task.title: Theme the site, the panel and PDFs
task.shortdesc: One stylesheet, named theme in opend.config.yaml, styles the docs site, the help panel and every PDF.

step.cmd: Override the --opend-* custom properties in your theme.

info.p: The link, hover, focus and highlight colours, headings, code backgrounds and note tints are derived from these, so a theme that sets only --opend-accent rebrands the whole site. To fine-tune, set the derived properties too: --opend-link, --opend-link-hover, --opend-accent-soft, --opend-focus, --opend-heading, --opend-border-strong, --opend-code-bg and --opend-on-accent. Layout properties are --opend-radius, --opend-radius-sm, --opend-shadow, --opend-measure (reading width), --opend-sidebar-width, --opend-header-height and --opend-layout-max.
Keep text readable: body text and links need a contrast of at least 4.5:1 against --opend-surface, in both colour schemes.
The image is shown before the site title in the page header. See the logo field in .

step.cmd: Optional: add print rules for PDFs.

info.p: The print document's body has the class publication. Useful hooks are .pub-cover, .pub-toc, .pub-chapter and .pub-part. PDFs always print in the light scheme.

step.cmd: Optional: choose how PDFs are laid out.

info.p: Page size, margins, cover, contents and running header and footer come from a PDF template; see .

step.cmd: Check the result on a page, in the help lab's panel and in the print HTML, at phone and desktop widths and in the light and dark schemes.

result.p: The theme loads after the built-in styles, and in PDFs after the print styles, so its rules win. This site's theme is site/theme/site.css. Custom rules can use the page's class names, such as .site-header, .toc (the sidebar on wide screens), .site-menu-panel (the panel the Menu button opens on narrow screens, with search, the contents and the PDF links), .opend-nav (both copies of the contents) and main.
result.note: In PDFs the theme is inlined into a document without a base URL, so url() references to fonts or images in it are not loaded. Use fonts installed on the server, or the system font stack.
result.p: Staff of a hosted site can also set a theme on the admin console's Appearance page, without changing the repository. It loads after this theme, so it wins where both set the same thing; see .
